articulation.label: weather
articulation.alt: weather: /w/ → /ɛ/ → /ð/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/ð/: Tongue tip at the teeth; add voice.

cards.title: Read and write
sections: Heart checks the weather forecast before a picnic. It says the temperature will be twenty degrees Celsius at noon. The morning will be cool, so she takes a sweater. Puck asks if they need a raincoat. The forecast says there will be no rain until the evening.
Why does Heart take a sweater, and do they expect rain at noon?
Write two sentences using two words from today’s new word bank.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 153 - Reading & Writing - 01

segments.name: Heart
segments.text: Heart checks the weather forecast before a picnic. It says the temperature will be twenty degrees Celsius at noon. The morning will be cool, so she takes a sweater. Puck asks if they need a raincoat. The forecast says there will be no rain until the evening.

cards.answer: The morning will be cool. No, they do not expect rain until the evening.
